user.description: Enter the URL of the llama.cpp server that exposes Prometheus metrics.

data_description.llama_url: Base URL of the llama.cpp server, e.g. http://192.168.1.197:8001
data_description.gpu_url: Optional base URL of the GPU metrics exporter, e.g. http://192.168.1.197:9091. Leave empty to skip GPU metrics.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the endpoints, in seconds (minimum 5).
